comparison.objective: Run a press stroke using continuous two-hand controls, then remove the finished part.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain simultaneous button actuation while staying out of the die, then retrieve the part.
comparison.success_condition: Both controls held throughout die closing and part removed afterward; complete timing tolerances are absent from the body.
comparison.reason: The candidate also requires safe control actuation after hands clear, but that generic safety primitive is not its core ability. The press record tests continuous bimanual safeguarding; the candidate tests adjustment/locking and measured damping over repeated cycles.
